summary: MineralRite (OTC: RITE) disclosed an 8-K reporting a September 30, 2026 agreement to repurchase 3,919,388 shares of its Series NMC $25 convertible preferred from Abstract Concepts 1618 LLC for $106,724,942, satisfied by issuing a non-interest-bearing promissory note in that principal amount rather than cash. The sinking-fund price was approximately $27.23 per share at closing, escalating 5% annually from the $25 par value, with a $25.40 floor. The deal permanently caps total sinking-fund payables at $269,049,058.76 across the 9,880,612 shares Abstract is expected to hold post-transaction. No advisor or board recommendation was named. Watch note repayment capacity and preferred overhang.
